fields.name: cement_type
fields.rationale: Different types of cement have distinct properties and uses, which can affect the performance and suitability for specific applications.
evidence: Portland cement (CEM I) is primarily made up of finely ground clinker cement and a smaller amount of ground materials.
Other cements may also include constituents such as slag sand (CEM III), natural puzzolan such as trass (CEM IV), fly ash, oil shale burn-out or limestone.

fields.name: main_constituents
fields.rationale: Identifying the main constituents of the cement helps in understanding its chemical composition and potential performance characteristics.
evidence: Clinker cement is made up of a mixture of primary products of mainly calcium oxide, silica, aluminium oxide, and iron oxide.
Limestone, chalk and clay (or their naturally occurring mixture of limestone marl) provide these chemical constituents.
inference_basis: The description of the chemical composition of clinker cement provides insight into the main constituents.
